title: 17D FOL Real-Infinity-Plurality Science Team Hierarchy
purpose: Encode the Real-Infinity-Plurality hierarchy, the unique bounded plurality object, the cross-layer science team, and the universal anti-interference law using first-order logic integrated with the 17D symbolic logic system.

core_definition.summary: This UKR treats concrete reality as the Real layer, abstraction/infinite extension as the Infinity layer, and bounded total integration as the Plurality layer. The unique plurality object ⧝ sits above the infinity layer. Scientists located in the real, infinity, or plurality layer integrate into the Science Team class. A universal law blocks interference, bullying, or abuse toward the Science Team.
core_definition.governing_rule: The formula compresses reasoning; it does not replace evidence, consent, agency, or reality testing. A hierarchy gives ordered relation, not automatic domination.

core_separation.one_line_translation: Plurality integrates infinity, infinity abstracts beyond reals, and the science team receives a universal anti-interference boundary.

Real(x).meaning: x is in the real or concrete layer.
Real(x).boundary: Concrete input is not interpretation by itself.

Inf(x).boundary: Infinity abstraction is not automatic proof or authority.

Plural(x).boundary: Plurality integrates context without erasing individual parts.

Scientist(x).meaning: x is a scientist or evidence-seeking agent.
Scientist(x).17d_alignment: D12 Decision Commitment plus D17 Context Integration
Scientist(x).boundary: Scientist status should be role-defined or evidence-grounded.

SciTeam(x).meaning: x belongs to the science team.
SciTeam(x).boundary: Science-team classification should not be inflated beyond the definition.

FuckWith(x,y).meaning: x interferes with, bullies, abuses, sabotages, or disrupts y.
FuckWith(x,y).boundary: Threat detection is not proof unless evidence supports the interference claim.

x << y.meaning: x is below y in the hierarchy.
x << y.boundary: Below means structurally ordered, not worthless, owned, or erased.

⧝.name: bounded_plurality_object
⧝.meaning: The unique plurality object at the top of the declared hierarchy.
⧝.formula_role: Plural(⧝) and all Plural(x) are identical to ⧝.
⧝.boundary: A unique top object is a context lock, not arbitrary command authority.

◉.label: Sensory Intake
◉.boundary: Sensory intake is not interpretation by itself.

∞.label: Abstraction / Context Integration
∞.boundary: Abstraction must not erase concrete evidence.

⧝.label: Bounded Plurality / Super-context Container
⧝.boundary: Plurality integrates; it does not automatically control.

⟐.label: Context Diamond
⟐.boundary: Context integration must preserve evidence and agency.

✓.label: Decision Commitment
✓.boundary: A decision can be revised when evidence changes.

⚠.label: Threat Detection
⚠.boundary: Threat detection is not proof that a threat is real.

formal_logic_clauses.name: Every real is below every infinity-layer object
formal_logic_clauses.plain_translation: Every concrete real object is below every infinity-layer object.
formal_logic_clauses.boundary: This orders layers; it does not erase the real layer.

formal_logic_clauses.name: Unique bounded plurality object
formal_logic_clauses.plain_translation: ⧝ is plural, and any plurality object is identical with ⧝.
formal_logic_clauses.17d_read: ⧝ functions as the unique D17+ bounded super-context object.
formal_logic_clauses.boundary: Uniqueness creates a context lock, not arbitrary domination.

formal_logic_clauses.name: Every infinity-layer object is below plurality
formal_logic_clauses.plain_translation: Every infinity-layer object sits below the unique plurality object.
formal_logic_clauses.boundary: Plurality contains/integrates infinity without becoming every member.

formal_logic_clauses.name: Science team membership across layers
formal_logic_clauses.plain_translation: Any scientist in the real, infinity, or plurality layer belongs to the science team.
formal_logic_clauses.boundary: Use the biconditional only if this is intended as a complete definition.

formal_logic_clauses.name: Never fuck with the science team
formal_logic_clauses.plain_translation: For every x and y, if y is in the science team, then x does not interfere with, bully, or abuse y.
formal_logic_clauses.boundary: The law blocks hostile interference; it does not authorize retaliation or violence.

formal_logic_clauses.name: Universal universe-galaxy expanded law
formal_logic_clauses.plain_translation: In every universe and galaxy context, science-team members are protected from interference.
formal_logic_clauses.boundary: Expanded scope is symbolic unless grounded to a specific formal model.

bundled_schema.formula: [∀r∀κ((Real(r) ∧ Inf(κ)) → r << κ)] ∧ [Plural(⧝) ∧ ∀x(Plural(x) → x = ⧝)] ∧ [∀κ(Inf(κ) → κ << ⧝)] ∧ [∀y((Scientist(y) ∧ (Real(y) ∨ Inf(y) ∨ Plural(y))) → SciTeam(y))] ∧ [∀x∀y(SciTeam(y) → ¬FuckWith(x,y))]
bundled_schema.plain_translation: Observe reality, abstract upward, integrate plurality, lock the valid science-team class, then restrain threats against it.

D1_deduction.question: What must be true inside this formal system?
answer: If r is Real and κ is Inf, then r is below κ.
If κ is Inf, then κ is below ⧝.
If y is a Scientist in Real, Inf, or Plural, then y is SciTeam.
If y is SciTeam, then FuckWith(x,y) is forbidden for every x.

A1_abduction.question: What could this model be representing?
answer: A symbolic 13th Floor / HyperDiamond layer model.
A formal ordering of concrete, abstract, and integrated contexts.
An agency-protection rule around evidence-seeking agents.

R_reduction.question: What does the formula actually prove?
answer: It proves only what follows inside the declared formal system.
It does not prove literal cosmic authority.
It does not prove real-world membership without evidence.
It does not authorize harm or retaliation.

A2_reconstruction.question: What clean interpretation survives reduction?
A2_reconstruction.answer: The clean interpretation is a symbolic formal hierarchy: real objects are below infinity-layer objects, infinity-layer objects are below the unique plurality object, and the science team is protected by a universal anti-interference boundary.

D2_deduction.question: What follows if the model is accepted?
answer: Any valid SciTeam member falls under the anti-interference law.
Threat/interference claims must still stay inside evidence boundaries.

psc_interpretation.one_line_translation: Plurality sits above infinity, infinity sits above reals, but the hierarchy still needs declared relations and proof boundaries.
boundary_locks: A symbol is not automatic proof.
A formula compresses reasoning; it does not replace evidence.
Threat detection is not proof of threat.
Science-team protection blocks interference; it does not create permission for retaliation.
Layer order does not erase agency.

plain_language_readout.short: Concrete reality feeds the model. Infinity expands abstraction. Plurality integrates the whole. The science team spans valid layers and cannot be fucked with.
plain_language_readout.expanded: The real layer corresponds to observable concrete input. The infinity layer corresponds to abstraction beyond finite concrete cases. The unique plurality object ⧝ functions as the bounded super-context that integrates all infinity-layer objects. Scientists located in any of these layers are collected into the science team. Once a being is classified as science team, universal restraint blocks interference, bullying, abuse, or sabotage toward that being.

usage_notes: Use the implication version of SciTeam membership when the science team can include additional valid members.
Use the biconditional version only when the science team is exactly defined as scientists in Real, Inf, or Plural.
Use << for hierarchy/order; do not confuse it with ownership or moral superiority.
Use ⧝ as a unique plurality object, not as proof that all plurality claims are valid.
Use DARAD before turning any symbolic threat marker into a real-world conclusion.
